plugins.name: context-economy
plugins.description: Handoffs that survive a context reset: a /handoff skill that writes and verifies them, plus hooks that write one automatically before compaction takes the session and inject the right one into the next.

plugins.name: core-skills
plugins.description: Project-agnostic catalog skills bundled into one installable plugin. Each skill reads .claude/project-context.md for any project-specific facts it needs. Currently: catchup, worktree, build-it, commit, fix-bug, grill-me, implement-plan, memory-hygiene, newbranch, next, pr, research, retro, review-branch, review-mcp-descriptions, shepard, sync-worktrees, task-writer, wireframe (with the bug-fix-verifier, wireframe-reviewer, runtime-integrity-reviewer, precedent-reviewer, and docs-accuracy-reviewer agents).
